output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds an arbitrary amount to the target's balance without ensuring it does not exceed the total supply, allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any user.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds a large amount to the _to balance, causing an overflow in balanceOf[_to] += _value; and allowing attackers to steal funds from other users.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds an arbitrary amount to the allowance, causing an overflow in allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; and allowing attackers to increase the allowance arbitrarily.

The mintToken function has a wrong logic. It directly assigns initialSupply to balanceOf[target], causing a large initial imbalance in the token distribution, allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any user.
The transfer function has a wrong logic. It directly assigns _value to balanceOf[_to], allowing attackers to steal funds from other users.
